import numpy as np, math
LOG23=math.log2(3.0); LN2=math.log(2.0)
z=np.exp(2j*np.pi/3)
G=sum(2.0**-b*z**-b for b in range(1,200))
def lamT(D, grid=0.01, bmax=20, t=0.0, omega=1.0):
    xs=np.arange(-D,D+1e-9,grid); n=len(xs)
    T=np.zeros((n,n))
    for b in range(1,bmax+1):
        w=math.exp(t*float(np.real(omega*(z**(-b)-G))))
        shift=LOG23-b
        for i,s in enumerate(xs):
            s2=s+shift
            if -D-1e-9<=s2<=D+1e-9:
                j=int(round((s2+D)/grid))
                if 0<=j<n: T[j,i]+=w
    v=np.ones(n)
    for _ in range(800):
        v=T@v; nv=np.linalg.norm(v); v/=nv
    return nv
